name: Cambridge Framework for Construction Productivity
description: This publication presents the Cambridge Framework for Construction Productivity, developed by the University of Cambridge Laing O'Rourke Centre through several years of collaboration with industry partners and analysis of data from more than 25 UK construction projects. The framework provides a consistent, practical method for measuring, benchmarking and improving productivity across project, work-package and activity levels. It shows how commonly available data, including programmes, digital models, progress records, labour data and productivity blockers, can be integrated to support live project control, empirical benchmarking and data analytics. The publication includes implementation guidance, case studies and examples covering structural frames, cladding and other work packages, demonstrating how structured data can support corrective action during delivery and improve planning, scheduling, cost estimation and risk analysis on future projects. It also outlines the potential for predictive analytics, machine learning and wider application across the construction sector.
